company.name: Northbeam Health Technologies Inc.
company.description: is a NASDAQ-listed digital health company commercializing an FDA-cleared AI imaging platform that helps radiologists detect cardiovascular and oncological conditions earlier. The platform is deployed across 240+ hospital networks with a recurring SaaS revenue model and 94% net revenue retention.

highlights.title: Recurring Revenue
highlights.text: $112M ARR growing 41% year-over-year with 94% net revenue retention across hospital networks.

highlights.title: Regulatory Moat
highlights.text: Seven FDA clearances and CE marking across cardiology and oncology imaging indications.

highlights.title: Embedded Distribution
highlights.text: Integrated with the three largest PACS vendors, reaching 70% of US hospital imaging volume.

highlights.title: Strong Balance Sheet
highlights.text: $86M in cash and no debt funds the path to profitability targeted for fiscal 2027.
